claim: In our planar layout, two rooms that share only part of an edge leave coincident walls that are not paired as a portal; every coincident edge must be one declared wall pair, including zero-height pieces to each other and to the street. (Blood's campaign has no such unpaired pair in 113,261 walls.)
evidence: Met repeatedly in Gravesend (2026-08-27 Market Slip, 2026-11-18 second walk); bloodmap/planar_layout.py:1619 reports unpaired_portal_candidates and bloodmap/geometry_audit.py:323 unpaired_coincident_walls; planar_layout.py:73-82 for the campaign's zero.
use: Join rooms through a neck whose whole face is the mouth, or cut the longer edge at the shorter one's ends.

checked.how: Opened bloodmap/planar_layout.py:73-82 (an unpaired shared edge makes two coincident solid walls; the campaign has none in 113,261 walls of 43 maps) and :1619 (conservation.unpaired_portal_candidates); bloodmap/geometry_audit.py:323 lists unpaired_coincident_walls.
